instruction: Export the file "Meeting-Agenda.docx" from the Desktop as a PDF and upload it to the 'meetings' directory in Google Drive under the original filename "Meeting-Agenda.pdf".

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting Meeting-Agenda.docx to PDF and uploading to Google Drive meetings folder. Evaluator checks that the PDF has exactly 1 page (the meeting agenda fits on one page) and verifies content exists (file size > 10KB).
metadata.verification: Verified by examining the docx content - the meeting agenda is a single-page document that should convert to a 1-page PDF.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file location (Google Drive 'meetings' directory) and filename ('Meeting-Agenda.pdf')
Page count check (exactly 1 page) is semantically correct and provides reasonable validation that the document was converted
Content verification (file size > 10KB) ensures the PDF is not empty and has actual content
Getter (get_googledrive_file) correctly extracts the file from the specified Google Drive path
Metric logic correctly reads PDF, counts pages, and validates file size
Expected value (1 page) is verified against actual docx content per metadata
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: Content verification only checks file size, not actual text content matching. However, the 1-page constraint provides indirect validation that the correct document was converted

Consider: Could theoretically pass with ANY 1-page PDF > 10KB, not necessarily the Meeting-Agenda content. But this is a common limitation in automated evaluation and acceptable given task constraints
